summary: DHT Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release providing a routine business update for Q2 2026. It estimates fleet TCE earnings at $126,700/day, VLCC spot at $162,600/day, and time charter at $90,800/day. It also notes booking of 48% of Q3 spot days at $139,700/day and a new 3-year time charter for the DHT Jaguar at $75,000/day starting September 2026. No special situation—just standard operational guidance.
